content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to show the weekly schedule configured in the program on the [product_name] [version_no] menu display?

I'm not entirely sure what you're asking. Do you mean that you'd like to view both ON and OFF times as a message on the [product_name] display and be able to change these times? Are you also referring to displaying the days of the week?
Perhaps this is the functionality you're looking for...
